 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 09-01-2024 1. Heard learned counsels for the parties.

2. This writ application has been filed for the following reliefs:-
"i) To hold and declare the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.15/84-85 for 3.7265 acre of land in village-Dih Per, Thana No.424 District-Begusarai as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed in terms of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Patna High Court CWJC No.7717 of 2016(2) dt.09-01-2024 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
ii) To hold and the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.15/84-85 as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed also in light of Section 11A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 as no award has been made uptil now since passing of the notification of Mukesh Kumar And Ors vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 9 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43517739/
3 publication in the year 1985 and declaration in the year 1986.
iii) To hold and declare that in light of Section 17(3-A) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, taking of the possession of the property of the petitioners without tendering payment of 80 percentum of the compensation is illegal and therefore no possession in the eyes of law.
iv) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to provide the cost of acquisition as define under Section 3(i) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as the respondent State has already constructed the road on the acquired property of the petitioners without making any award and without payment of any compensation thereafter.
v) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to pass an award under the new Act on the basis of the current market value of the lands in question in light of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and compensate the petitioners accordingly.
Patna High Court CWJC No.7717 of 2016(2) dt.09-01-2024 vi) To issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to also award solatium as per Section 30 of the new Act, interest @ 15% in light of Section 80 of the new Act read with Section 34 of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
vii) To any other relief or reliefs for which the petitioners is found to be entitled in the facts and circumstances of the case."
